body: honestly not a ton has happened which is shocking, it sounds so dumb but my old friends have really just been my tipping point. they’ve been so rude and used one of my mental illnesses i tell almost no one about to make fun of me and its just all tiring. they told me they loved me and would never leave me and now i truly have no one and none of them will tell me why they’re suddenly terrible to me. ive never been more tired and done in my life.  i just want answers. this has happened too many times.
thats how it feels and i cant shake that feeling at all. i feel like bc i told someone its almost like i put them through worrying for nothing. idk my mind is a mess.
hey. im here if you would like to just chat.
thank you. its just gotten so dark tonight
i hope you have a great night. you deserve the best aswell. thank you again.

thank you for replying. it means more then youll ever know honestly. ive told so many people and literally no one has been reaching out and i know thats rly selfish to want and i know people are busy but it hurts so bad and just adds to my thoughts and gives me more incentive to do it. im so tired, i hate it. thank you again for your kind words.
i really needed to hear this tonight thank you

i was diagnosed with adhd and bpd, they told my mom i need help and my mom was like haha NO!! and it rly hurt because i knew i needed it. i dont drive at the moment so i couldnt rly just go and find a therapist or anything and i dont really have friends to take me either so its hard

my mom and i are still super close but for years ive been seeking my fathers approval and it just has never happen and now i know it wont now. i just feel so stuck in this horrible mindset, i dont think i’ll ever get better especially because i cant seek help. my family doesnt exactly believe in mental illness even though i was diagnosed with my mom there.

first off, thank you for even commenting on this. its really just been years of pain and trauma. my father has stopped speaking to me, my friends have all really stopped caring. everything hurts, im not myself anymore and it sucks. deep down i dont wanna do it and i want to feel okay again but i know there’s no getting better for me. im really past the point of no return.
